process_area.title: Renewable Asset Performance, REC & Decarbonization Analytics

value_stream.name: On-Site Renewable Energy & Prosumer Asset Operations

fields.Participants: Sustainability/ESG Manager (links to VS-25), Energy Manager, Finance (links to VS-17), Legal (links to VS-100.3), REC Registry/Broker
fields.Trigger: Generation (W3457); REC market opportunity; ESG disclosure cycle

workflows.name: Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) / Carbon Offset Generation, Registry & Trading

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-register of "register eligible generation with the recognized REC registry" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-count of "account, serialization, and transactions" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "document REC creation/retire/trade for audit" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-555 (ensure controlled execution — Renewable Asset Performance, REC & Decarbonization Analytics (PA-108.3).)
- operational: clear attribution and registry discipline; operational: contract clause (W3455)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Double-counting risk**: Claiming and selling the same REC; mitigated by clear attribution and registry discipline
- **Attribute-loss risk**: PPA/lease cedes REC ownership unintentionally; mitigated by contract clause (W3455)
System Touchpoints: - REC registry; ESG metrics (links to VS-25.1/W192); finance/GL (links to VS-17.1); legal (links to VS-100.3); audit (links to VS-21)

steps.activity: Sustainability/Energy Manager determine REC/offset eligibility and ownership per ownership model (W3455): own-and-operate → BuildRight owns RECs; PPA/lease → attribute ownership per contract; register eligible generation with the recognized REC registry (e.g., I-REC)

Sustainability/Finance create/retire/trade RECs per strategy: retire to support BuildRight's own Scope 2/RE100 claim (W3466), or sell/trade for revenue where the claim is not needed; manage registry account, serialization, and transactions

Sustainability/Legal document REC creation/retire/trade for audit (links to VS-21) and ESG disclosure (links to VS-25.3/W3470), ensure no double-counting (own-use vs sold), and report REC outcome to the performance review (W3468) and governance (W3472)

fields.Participants: Sustainability/ESG Manager (links to VS-25), Energy Manager, Finance (links to VS-17.4), External Assurance (links to VS-21/W341)
fields.Trigger: Annual GHG inventory (links to VS-25.1/W192); ESG reporting cycle

workflows.name: GHG Emissions Reduction Accounting & Scope 2 Attribution

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "Sustainability/Energy Manager compute renewable contribution to Scope 2" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "methodology against GHG Protocol/SEC/IFRS S2 and external assurance" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "review and integrate to climate disclosure" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-555 (ensure controlled execution — Renewable Asset Performance, REC & Decarbonization Analytics (PA-108.3).)
- operational: GHG Protocol adherence and assurance; operational: attribution discipline (W3465)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Methodology-error risk**: Wrong emission factor/methodology mis-states reduction; mitigated by GHG Protocol adherence and assurance
- **Claim-vs-actual risk**: Claiming reduction without REC retirement (market-based); mitigated by attribution discipline (W3465)
System Touchpoints: - ESG/GHG metrics (links to VS-25.1/W192); SCADA generation; finance (links to VS-17.4); assurance (links to VS-21/W341)

steps.activity: Sustainability/Energy Manager compute renewable contribution to Scope 2 (location-based and market-based): self-generated MWh (W3457) reducing grid import, and retired RECs (W3465) reducing market-based Scope 2; reconcile to the GHG inventory (links to VS-25.1/W192)

Sustainability/Finance compute the emissions avoided (tCO2e) vs the grid emission factor, validate methodology against GHG Protocol/SEC/IFRS S2 and external assurance (links to VS-21/W341 ESG assurance audit), and document for disclosure

Sustainability report Scope 2 reduction and progress vs the decarbonization target (links to VS-25.1/VS-25.3) to the ESG review and integrate to climate disclosure (W3470); feed outcomes to the renewable roadmap (W3449) and governance (W3472)

fields.Participants: Energy Manager, BI (links to VS-28.1), Sustainability/ESG Manager, Facilities (links to VS-20.3)

workflows.name: Renewable Asset Performance Benchmarking & Portfolio Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-identify of "identify top/bottom performers, root-cause variance" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report to governance" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-555 (ensure controlled execution — Renewable Asset Performance, REC & Decarbonization Analytics (PA-108.3).)
- operational: normalization; operational: root-cause and action tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Benchmark-distortion risk**: Comparing unlike sites (orientation/age) mis-ranks; mitigated by normalization
- **Under-performer-neglect risk**: Bottom performers left unaddressed; mitigated by root-cause and action tracking
System Touchpoints: - SCADA/BI (links to VS-28.1); energy analytics; asset register (links to VS-35); vendor scorecard (links to VS-67)

steps.activity: Energy Manager/BI compute per-site and portfolio KPIs: specific yield (kWh/kWp), performance ratio, availability, capacity factor, self-consumption ratio, and savings (W3463); benchmark sites against each other, against Pvsyst expectation (W3450), and against industry

Energy Manager/Sustainability identify top/bottom performers, root-cause variance (orientation, soiling, O&M quality, degradation, shading, DU issues), and best-practice transfer across sites; prioritize under-performers for action (W3459/W3460)

Energy Manager publish the portfolio performance dashboard, feed insights to the roadmap (W3449), O&M vendor scorecard (links to VS-67), and asset-renewal planning (W3469); report to governance (W3472)

fields.Frequency: Monthly + quarterly + annual (per the Trigger and step 2 cadence)
fields.Participants: Energy Manager, Finance (links to VS-17.4/VS-40), Treasury (links to VS-18), Sustainability/ESG Manager

workflows.name: Renewable Investment ROI, Savings Realization & Benefits Tracking

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "track benefits realization per site" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-reconcile of "reconcile benefits to the capex investment" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "Energy Manager/CFO report ROI and benefits realization to the" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-555 (ensure controlled execution — Renewable Asset Performance, REC & Decarbonization Analytics (PA-108.3).)
- operational: metered reconciliation; operational: Tax coordination (links to VS-79)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Over-stated-benefit risk**: Optimistic savings vs actual; mitigated by metered reconciliation
- **Incentive-non-capture risk**: Eligible incentives not claimed; mitigated by Tax coordination (links to VS-79)
System Touchpoints: - Finance/FP&A (links to VS-17.4); capex (links to VS-40); treasury (links to VS-18); energy analytics (links to VS-28.1)

steps.activity: Energy Manager/Finance track benefits realization per site: actual savings (W3463), REC revenue (W3465), avoided emissions value, resilience value, and incentive captured, vs the business case (W3451); compute actual payback/IRR vs plan

Finance/Energy Manager reconcile benefits to the capex investment (links to VS-40) and operating cost (O&M, insurance, financing), compute portfolio ROI, and identify benefit shortfalls and drivers (yield, tariff, O&M overrun)

Energy Manager/CFO report ROI and benefits realization to the performance review (W3472) and executives (links to VS-33.2); re-baseline laggard sites and feed learning to future projects (W3449/W3451)

fields.Participants: Energy Manager, Fixed Asset (links to VS-35), Finance (links to VS-17), Procurement (links to VS-03)
fields.Trigger: Asset age/degradation analytics; warranty expiry; technology advance

workflows.name: Asset Lifecycle, Degradation & Renewable Refresh/Repower Planning

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-track of "track asset lifecycle and degradation" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "evaluate refresh/repower options" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-update of "update the asset register" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-555 (ensure controlled execution — Renewable Asset Performance, REC & Decarbonization Analytics (PA-108.3).)
- operational: degradation analytics; operational: certified recycling (links to VS-99/VS-157)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Degradation-blindspot risk**: Untracked degradation silently erodes yield; mitigated by degradation analytics
- **Disposal-compliance risk**: Improper e-waste disposal breaches DENR rules; mitigated by certified recycling (links to VS-99/VS-157)
System Touchpoints: - Asset register (links to VS-35/W399); capex (links to VS-40); e-waste (links to VS-99/VS-157); procurement (links to VS-03)

steps.activity: Energy Manager/Fixed Asset track asset lifecycle and degradation: annual yield decline vs nameplate, component health (modules, inverters, BESS), warranty expiry (W3453/W3460), residual life, and asset-retirement obligation (links to VS-35); forecast end-of-life

Energy Manager/Finance evaluate refresh/repower options: inverter replacement, module upgrade (higher efficiency), BESS addition, or full repower; model economics vs continued operation (W3451 methodology) and technology/tariff outlook

Energy Manager/Procurement plan and execute refresh/repower (links to W3452/W3453/W3454), retire/dispose of replaced assets per asset-retirement (links to VS-35.3) and e-waste rules (links to VS-99/VS-157), and update the asset register (links to VS-35) and roadmap (W3449)

fields.Participants: Sustainability/ESG Manager (links to VS-25), Energy Manager, Finance (links to VS-17), Legal (links to VS-100), Assurance (links to VS-21/W341)
fields.Trigger: Annual ESG/SEC/IFRS S2 reporting (links to VS-25.3); assurance cycle

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-compile of "compile renewable-energy data for ESG/climate disclosure" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validate the disclosure for accuracy and consistency with financial statements" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-track of "Sustainability publish the disclosure" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-555 (ensure controlled execution — Renewable Asset Performance, REC & Decarbonization Analytics (PA-108.3).)
- operational: accuracy, assurance, and conservative claims; operational: reconciliation
Pain Points / Risks: - **Greenwashing risk**: Overstated/mis-stated claims attract regulator/reputational risk; mitigated by accuracy, assurance, and conservative claims
- **Disclosure-inconsistency risk**: ESG vs financial data mismatch; mitigated by reconciliation
System Touchpoints: - ESG metrics/disclosure (links to VS-25.3); finance (links to VS-17); assurance (links to VS-21/W341); legal (links to VS-100)

steps.activity: Sustainability/Energy Manager compile renewable-energy data for ESG/climate disclosure: generation, self-consumption, export, Scope 2 reduction (W3466), REC retirement (W3465), capacity, and investment; align to reporting frameworks (GRI, SASB, TCFD/IFRS S2, SEC) per the ESG reporting standard (links to VS-25.3)

Finance/Legal validate the disclosure for accuracy and consistency with financial statements (links to VS-17), green-finance use-of-proceeds reporting (if green-loan links to W3451), and regulatory requirements; obtain external assurance (links to VS-21/W341)

Sustainability publish the disclosure (sustainability report, climate report, investor/lender reporting), integrate to the ESG narrative (links to VS-25), and report to the board/sustainability committee (links to VS-36); ensure forward targets are credible and tracked (W3472)

fields.Participants: Energy Manager, Risk (links to VS-21.2), Insurance (links to VS-26), HSE (links to VS-24), Finance (links to VS-17)
fields.Trigger: Annual risk review (links to VS-21.2); insurance cycle (links to VS-26)

workflows.name: Renewable Portfolio Risk, Resilience & Insurance Governance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-log of "technology/manufacturer risk, weather/climate risk" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "Insurance/Risk ensure adequate coverage for the renewable assets" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-report of "report portfolio risk, resilience, and insurance status to executives" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-555 (ensure controlled execution — Renewable Asset Performance, REC & Decarbonization Analytics (PA-108.3).)
- operational: annual review; operational: cybersecurity controls (links to VS-27)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Under-insurance risk**: Renewable assets under-covered for replacement/BI; mitigated by annual review
- **Cyber-exposure risk**: Internet-connected SCADA/inverters are attack surface; mitigated by cybersecurity controls (links to VS-27.3)
System Touchpoints: - ERM/risk register (links to VS-21.2); insurance (links to VS-26.3/W59); HSE (links to VS-24); cyber (links to VS-27.3); BCP (links to VS-26)

steps.activity: Energy Manager/Risk maintain the renewable-portfolio risk view: technology/manufacturer risk, weather/climate risk (typhoon links to VS-69), regulatory risk (net-metering/export links to W3462), fire/safety risk (W3464), cyber risk (SCADA/monitoring links to VS-27.3), and counterparty risk (PPA/lease/EPC/O&M); integrate to ERM (links to VS-21.2)

Insurance/Risk ensure adequate coverage for the renewable assets (property, business interruption, third-party liability, cyber) within the group insurance program (links to VS-26.3/W59), set deductibles/limits, and manage claims (links to W3464); review annually

Energy Manager/Risk report portfolio risk, resilience, and insurance status to executives (links to VS-33.2) and the risk/audit committee (links to VS-36/VS-21); ensure controls, BCP (links to VS-26), and incident readiness (W3464) are maintained

fields.Participants: Sustainability/ESG Manager, Energy Manager, CFO, COO, Risk (links to VS-21.2), Board/Sustainability Committee (links to VS-36)
fields.Trigger: Annual strategy/policy review; board cycle (links to VS-36)

workflows.name: Renewable Energy Program Strategy, Policy & Executive/Board Governance

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-renew of "renewable-energy program strategy and policy" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "Energy Manager/Sustainability/ESG Manager conduct the quarterly program review" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System rule-based auto-approval of "approve policy updates" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-555 (ensure controlled execution — Renewable Asset Performance, REC & Decarbonization Analytics (PA-108.3).)
- operational: annual review and board oversight; operational: roadmap governance and target tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Strategy-drift risk**: Program drifts from corporate strategy/targets; mitigated by annual review and board oversight
- **Under-investment risk**: Insufficient pace vs the ESG target; mitigated by roadmap governance and target tracking
System Touchpoints: - Policy repository (links to VS-186); ESG (links to VS-25); strategy/performance (links to VS-33); capex (links to VS-40); board reporting (links to VS-36)

steps.activity: Sustainability/ESG Manager/Energy Manager maintain the renewable-energy program strategy and policy: generation targets, ownership-model preference (W3455), investment limits (links to VS-40), O&M/asset-management standards, ESG-attribute policy (W3465), and authority matrix; align to corporate strategy (links to VS-33) and ESG plan (links to VS-25)

Energy Manager/Sustainability/ESG Manager conduct the quarterly program review: portfolio performance (W3467), benefits realization (W3468), roadmap progress (W3449), risk/insurance (W3471), and disclosure readiness (W3470); decide program adjustments and resource allocation

CFO/CSO report the renewable-energy program (performance, investment, risk, ESG contribution) to the executive committee (links to VS-33.2) and Board/Sustainability Committee (links to VS-36); ensure alignment with the capital, ESG, and resilience strategy and approve policy updates
